name: rosetta-letter-frequency
code:
use default

let text =
    "Now is the time for all good men to come to the aid of their country"

let counts =
    text
        |> filter(c => char.is_letter(c))
        |> group_by(c => char.to_lower_invariant(c))

for letter in counts.keys |> sort_by(k => k) do
    write_line("{letter}: {counts[letter].count}")
od
